description.value:
You have continued in your worship of Aspalasch, and the ocean spirit has granted you greater powers. Choose a spell from air bubble, create water, and sanctuary. You can cast that spell as a 1st-rank divine innate spell once per day. You may choose each morning which cantrip you would like to cast from Aspalasch Worshipper.

If you select this feat at 9th level, you can additionally choose from @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.Environmental Endurance], @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.Water Breathing], and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.Water Walk]. You can cast that spell as a 2nd-rank divine innate spell once per day.

Special You can select this feat more than once. If you do, you must select a different spell.
